weekly.title: ADR surging in Outer Banks (Dare County): +12.4% — raise prices or sell signal
weekly.body: ADR in Outer Banks (Dare County) jumped 12.4% to $415. If you own here: raise nightly rates immediately. If prospective buyer: market strengthening, but competition for inventory will increase.
weekly.action_required: If owner: update nightly rates now. If prospective: accelerate property search.

weekly.action_required: Watch for continued decline before adjusting strategy.

weekly.title: Buncombe County Commission votes to extend owner-occupancy STR rule to unincorporated areas
weekly.body: The Buncombe County Commission voted 4-3 Tuesday to extend Asheville's owner-occupancy short-term rental requirement to unincorporated county areas, effective September 1, 2025. Non-owner-occupied vacation rental permits will no longer be issued outside city limits. Existing permit holders have 90 days to comply or cease operations.
weekly.action_required: Identify which zones are affected. Verify any target property is in a permissive zone. Request zoning verification letter from county before purchase.

weekly.title: SC House Bill 4250 introduced: allows municipalities to require owner-occupancy for vacation rentals
weekly.body: South Carolina House Bill 4250, introduced this week, would amend the 2020 STR preemption law to allow municipalities to require owner-occupancy for short-term rentals in residential zones. If passed, it could affect all SC coastal markets including Hilton Head, Isle of Palms, and Pawleys Island. The bill is currently in the House Judiciary Committee with a hearing scheduled for May 14.
weekly.action_required: Identify which zones are affected. Verify any target property is in a permissive zone. Request zoning verification letter from county before purchase.

all.title: North Carolina Senate Bill 608 'STR Freedom Act' would preempt local short-term rental bans statewide
all.body: NC Senate Bill 608, introduced by Sen. Johnson (R-Wake), would prohibit municipalities from banning short-term rentals that hold a valid state STR license. The bill passed the Senate Commerce Committee on a 7-2 vote and heads to the full Senate floor. If enacted, it would effectively override Asheville's owner-occupancy requirement and prevent similar bans in other NC cities.
all.action_required: Track bill progress through legislature. If passed, removes a key risk from SC/NC markets. No immediate action required.

all.title: Isle of Palms STR permit cap reached — no new short-term rental licenses until October review
all.body: The City of Isle of Palms announced this week that its annual cap of 1,400 active STR permits has been reached. No new permits will be issued until the October 2025 annual review. Existing permits are automatically renewed. Buyers should verify permit transferability before closing on any IOP property intended for short-term rental use.
all.action_required: Note new permit requirements and fees. Verify if cap affects new purchases. If buying: confirm permit availability before closing.

all.title: Dare County launches new STR registry — $75 annual fee, no permit caps or new restrictions
all.body: Dare County announced a new short-term rental registry effective July 1, 2025, requiring all STR operators to register annually at a fee of $75/year. The registry is informational only — no caps on new registrations and no owner-occupancy requirements. Officials emphasized the registry is for emergency contact purposes, not regulation.
all.action_required: Note new permit requirements and fees. Verify if cap affects new purchases. If buying: confirm permit availability before closing.
